paragraphs: On Saturday night, Tom and Ben slept in a tent in the garden. The two boys wanted to sleep outside for the first time. Dad put the tent next to the old tree. He put two soft blankets inside. The garden was dark, and only one small lamp was on in the tent. Ben brought his new guitar. It was his first instrument. "It is hard to play," he said. "But I want to play a song for you." He played loudly, and the sound was terrible. Tom laughed so much that he fell on his bag.

"It is not bad," said Tom. "Well, it is terrible, but it is funny." Pip came into the tent with his toy duck. He pushed the duck with his nose, and it made a loud noise. Ben played louder, and Pip pushed the duck harder. The noise went across the garden. A light came on in the house.

Tom looked out of the tent. Someone was coming across the grass. The person had a flashlight. Ben stopped playing. "Who is it?" he asked. "Is it Mom, or Dad, or someone from next door?" What do you think happens next? Does the person say, "Be quiet"? Guess before you read the next part.

It was Dad. "It is late," he said. "Please play quietly." Then he sat between the boys and smiled. "But I know an easy song. Give me the guitar." Dad showed Ben three easy sounds, and Ben played them slowly. Tom sang quietly, and Pip put the duck down. Soon Pip was asleep. The tent was quiet, and the night was nice.
